test_stash_with_skippable: test stashing a tensor using the skippable decorator and stash function in a PyTorch module
test_pop_stash_connection: test popping a stashed tensor across two skippable modules connected in a skip connection pipeline
test_skippable_declaration_validation: test that skippable modules raise RuntimeError when stash or pop keys are declared but not used
test_skip_tracker_context: test using SkipTracker with use_skip_tracker context manager to track stashed tensors during forward passes
test_stash_none_value: test stashing a None value using the skippable decorator without raising an error
